title: Powers of the noise parameter
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho,\lambda\in\mathbb{R}$ with $0\le\rho$, and let $k$ be a natural number. Then $\bigl((\rho^{1-\lambda})^k\bigr)^2=\bigl((\rho^k)^2\bigr)^{1-\lambda}$.
